_comment: Optional per-PROJECT config for the pr-walkthrough skill. Place at .guardian/pr-walkthrough.config.json and commit it. All fields are optional — the skill runs generic phases with defaults and discloses what it skipped. Per-DEVELOPER settings do not belong here; put those in .guardian/pr-walkthrough.local.json, which is not committed and is shallow-merged over this file.
_priorArtifacts: Marker comments on the PR that the walkthrough ingests as INPUT to adjudicate, rather than re-deriving. Each is located by grepping issue comments for its marker string.
_docDirs: Where concept/pattern/practice docs live. Used to check whether a behavior change contradicts documented behavior, and to flag domains with no doc.
_issueTracker: Used when proposing that a finding be deferred to a ticket rather than fixed in the PR.
_checklistsFile: Stack-specific blind-spot checks, injected into Phase 1 (classification) and Phase 3 (per-slice bench).
_perDeveloperFields: notesPath and recordDestination are intentionally absent here. They are personal paths — a committed value imposes one person's setup on the whole team. See pr-walkthrough.local.example.json.
